name: Tsunoda Keiko
source: A physical education teacher at the Senkawa(?) school and Genki's sempai since studying at the university. An exacting and assertive woman who takes pleasure in making fun of the the protagonist and forcing him to work overtime. But despite her funny nature, Keiko becomes serious, when it comes to interceding for the students.
